why: Fix round two for ticket 1067 in next/ and our tooling, after the recheck row 2026-11-15-t1067-review2, under 0564: one agent wrote the law and the fix (0177). Law R18 in next/packages/vitest/src/Recorder.test.ts writes the inferred call on Shelf, impl inline with its symbol member: a fails entry impl leaves out under @ts-expect-error, the same call with a valid entry and no directive, and a misspelled impl key under @ts-expect-error. It was red on the reviewed Recorder.ts (the directive went unused). The cause: an inline impl widens [ShelfId]: ShelfId to symbol, so the inferred impl type no longer fits the service, TypeScript falls back to the constraint, and every key reads as given. The fix in next/packages/vitest/src/Recorder.ts infers only impl's keys (K extends keyof S), never its values, so fails is Fails<S, Method<S> & K>; the impl-keys guard Own and the type parameter P go, and the ordinary excess property check refuses a misspelled impl key again. R17 now names layer by impl's keys. The reviewer's call is refused on the fixed code, and so are its two-symbol and held-in-a-variable cases.
note: Exclude<keyof P, symbol> would not have helped: P had already fallen back to the whole constraint, so its keys were every key. The pr tooling call sites, checked with a throwaway config, show the same 20 older errors in Queue.test.ts (ticket 486) as on the reviewed module, and nothing new.

plants.plant: real module: fails typed Fails<S>, every method again; R18's directive goes unused in tsc, and R17 goes red too
